PenStarS Pen Button Mapper

Air Actions, wherever.

Map S Pen clicks and Air Actions to your favourite actions, even in apps that don't provide their own Air Action support. Control media, navigate, or run your own touch sequence.

FeaturesCompatibilityScreenshotsSupport
Google PlayDirect Download

Features

01

Make every gesture useful

Assign actions to clicks, double clicks, long clicks, directional gestures, pointy gestures, circles, and shake.

02

Air Actions for all apps

Use your S Pen to control apps even when their developers haven't implemented Air Actions.

03

Dozens of built-in actions

Open apps, manage media playback, change system settings, launch digital assistants, perform system actions, and more.

04

Customised actions

Create your own touch sequences, run custom Tasker tasks, or invoke Android intents.

05

Create multiple App Actions

Create App Actions, which are a set of actions for the buttons and gestures you choose for a collection of apps.

06

Backup and restore

Share individual App Actions with others or backup your entire configuration for safekeeping.

Compatibility

PenStar compatibility and license requirements
AndroidAndroid 8.1 or later. Available features can vary by Android version.
HardwareA Samsung device with Bluetooth S Pen support is required.
PermissionsNotifications, Read Logs, and Accessibility are required. Other permissions are optional and requested when using specific features.
LicenseAll features and up to two App Actions are free. More than two App Actions require a one-time purchase.
